scenes.headline: Approve risky actions from your phone
scenes.body: Deploy api@6f57b86 to production? Rollback plan and runbook are linked before approval.
scenes.footer: Agent Tick records the decision. Your workflow still runs the deploy.

scenes.headline: Choose from bounded options
scenes.body: The agent needs a direction before continuing. Each option is explicit, and stop is always available.
scenes.footer: No arbitrary remote prompt or shell access.

scenes.headline: See progress while you are AFK
scenes.body: Tests finished. Waiting on approval before publishing the release. Previous updates stay easy to review.
scenes.footer: Notifications stay brief; details live in the app.

scenes.headline: Hosted or self-hosted setup
scenes.body: Use agenttick.sh for managed routing and push, or connect the app to your own Agent Tick server.
scenes.footer: One app supports hosted and self-hosted teams.

scenes.headline: Clear app-store entitlement copy
scenes.body: Lifetime app unlock keeps self-hosted use available on this app-store account. Hosted personal service is optional.
scenes.footer: Viewing and settings remain available after trial.
